verdict.rationale: Docs claim elastic scaling and configurable concurrency limits (which imply capacity scaling) and self-hosting gives infra control, plus task-level retries provide some resilience, but there's no explicit documentation of adding worker nodes to a fleet, load-balancing runs across workers, or the platform surviving a worker crash mid-execution. missing for 10: explicit worker-fleet/horizontal-scaling architecture docs, load-balancing mechanism across workers, and documented worker-crash recovery/failover behavior.
